% TS_fu14_df, note below the table. Generated by analysis/paper_assets_isc.py; do not edit.
$D_F$ is the difference between two platforms beyond recompilation with the float32 trunk, minus the same difference with the bfloat16 trunk at the default precision, in percentage points. It reads reduced if its interval lies below 0. Where float32 recompilation was not measured on the first-named platform, it is set to 0, so $D_F$ is an upper bound.
